name: token-watch
description: Plan usage, the context window and the prompt cache countdown as a banner above the Claude Code prompt, with burn rates, alerts and an opt-in keep-warm. TW Settings picks what it shows; TW Monitor lists every session's context and cache. /token-watch hides the banner, or prints it as text where it can't be drawn.

snapshot.title: Usage snapshot files
snapshot.description: Write each reading under ~/.claude/token-watch/: usage.json for Token Watch for VS Code, and a file per session in sessions/ for TW Monitor. Local only; no other file is touched.
